settings.title: Settings
settings.calendarHint: Import an .ics export from Outlook (File → Save calendar). Each import replaces the previously imported events; your kind and project assignments are kept. Events shown as free (reminders, other people’s holidays) do not block time. Recurring series are imported as a single occurrence in this prototype; a later version connects to Microsoft 365 directly.
settings.imported: {{total}} events imported, previous import replaced ({{kept}} already known, {{removed}} removed). {{skipped}} recurring series imported as a single occurrence.
settings.aiHint: The key is stored only in this browser on this machine and sent directly to the provider. It is never written to the repository or included in exports.
settings.dataHint: The Zendo server stores everything in a SQLite database and keeps a copy every day. Export a JSON copy whenever you like.
settings.sampleConfirm: Replace all current data with sample data?
settings.clearConfirm: Delete all data? This cannot be undone.
settings.shortcutGo: then t · w · i · c · p · b · r — go to view
settings.m365Hint: Reads your Outlook calendar through the Zendo server, which refreshes it at start and every 15 minutes while running. Sign-in tokens stay on the server; the browser never sees them.
settings.deviceCodeWait: and enter this code. This page continues once you are signed in.
settings.serviceDown: The Zendo server is not reachable right now.
settings.budgetHint: outside this window (evenings) meetings do not reduce the day
settings.importConfirm: Replace all current data with the contents of this file?
settings.importInvalid: This file is not a Zendo export. Nothing was changed.
settings.m365NotConfigured: Microsoft 365 is not configured: add MS_CLIENT_ID and MS_TENANT_ID to .env (see docs/outlook-setup.md) and restart.
settings.aiServer: The Zendo server uses {{provider}} · {{model}} with the key stored there. Auto in Clarify sends the inbox text and project names; Propose in Week sends project names, headline goals, due dates, open-work figures and free hours per day – no task or meeting titles.
settings.aiServerMissing: No AI key on the Zendo server. Add ANTHROPIC_API_KEY (or OPENAI_API_KEY) to its settings and restart Zendo; the key stays on the server and never reaches the browser.
settings.aiBrowserFallback: Fallback: key stored in this browser
settings.aiRemoveBrowserKey: Remove the key stored in this browser (no longer needed)

sync.online: Saved on the Zendo server, with a copy every day.
sync.offline: The Zendo server is not reachable. Changes are kept in this browser and sent when it is back.
sync.local: Running without the Zendo server: data lives in this browser only until the server can be reached.
sync.signin: Your sign-in has expired. Changes are kept in this browser and sent once you have signed in again.
sync.conflict: This browser and the server hold different data – please choose which to keep.
sync.conflictBody: This browser holds data that differs from what is on the server. This happens on the first start after switching to the server when another browser or address connected first. Nothing has been changed yet.
sync.conflictBackup: A copy of this browser’s data has been kept; you can download it later from Settings → Data.
sync.keepBrowser: Keep this browser’s data and replace the server
sync.keepServer: Use the server’s data and replace this browser
sync.downloadBackup: Download the copy taken before the first sync
